mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.quantity, o.time_purchased, o.time_filled, o.purchase_price, o.status AS orderstatus_id, os.orderstatus_name, c.client_id, c.email AS client_email, c.cash_balance AS client_cash_balance, c.password_hash AS client_password_hash, c.address AS client_address, c.phone_number AS client_phone_number, c.ssn AS client_ssn, i.instrument_id, i.symbol AS instrument_symbol, i.symbol_name AS instrument_symbol_name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_status os ON o.status = os.orderstatus_id LEFT JOIN clients c ON o.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN instruments i ON o.instrument_id = i.instrument_id WHERE o.order_id = #{id}

SELECT o.order_id, o.quantity, o.time_purchased, o.time_filled, o.purchase_price, o.status AS orderstatus_id, os.orderstatus_name, c.client_id, c.email AS client_email, c.cash_balance AS client_cash_balance, c.password_hash AS client_password_hash, c.address AS client_address, c.phone_number AS client_phone_number, c.ssn AS client_ssn, i.instrument_id, i.symbol AS instrument_symbol, i.symbol_name AS instrument_symbol_name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_status os ON o.status = os.orderstatus_id LEFT JOIN clients c ON o.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN instruments i ON o.instrument_id = i.instrument_id

SELECT o.order_id, o.quantity, o.time_purchased, o.time_filled, o.purchase_price, o.status AS orderstatus_id, os.orderstatus_name, c.client_id, c.email AS client_email, c.cash_balance AS client_cash_balance, c.password_hash AS client_password_hash, c.address AS client_address, c.phone_number AS client_phone_number, c.ssn AS client_ssn, i.instrument_id, i.symbol AS instrument_symbol, i.symbol_name AS instrument_symbol_name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_status os ON o.status = os.orderstatus_id LEFT JOIN clients c ON o.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN instruments i ON o.instrument_id = i.instrument_id WHERE c.client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY o.time_purchased ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (client_id, instrument_id, quantity, time_purchased, time_filled, purchase_price, status) VALUES (#{client.id}, #{instrument.id}, #{quantity}, #{timeOfPurchase}, #{timeFilled}, #{purchasePrice}, #{status.id})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET client_id = #{client.id}, instrument_id = #{instrument.id}, quantity = #{quantity}, time_purchased = #{timeOfPurchase}, time_filled = #{timeFilled}, purchase_price = #{purchasePrice}, status = #{status.id} WHERE order_id = #{id}
